title: Seahawks' Walker, 'one of one,' earns MVP honors

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Seahawks' Walker, 'one of one,' earns MVP honors
sources.description: Buoyed by a first-half surge in which he outgained the entire Patriots offense, Seahawks running back Kenneth Walker III, a pending unrestricted free agent, earned MVP honors as Seattle ran to a 29-13 victory Sunday.
